text:
Little feet of a child,
blue with cold,
how people see you and do not cover you,
my God!

Little wounded feet
by every pebble,
violated by snow
and mud!

Blind man does not know
that wherever you pass,
a flower of living light
you leave;

that where you set
your bleeding little foot,
the nard grows more
fragrant.

Since you walk
along straight roads,
be heroic, as you are,
perfect.

Little feet of a child,
two suffering jewels,
how people pass by
without seeing you!

translation.title: Little Feet
